clips.name: lv-w4-day
clips.prompt: Misty cascades: the waterfalls pour and shimmer steadily, white mist rolls slowly at their feet and drifts between the cliffs, the pool ripples. Static locked-off camera, the painting itself does not change, only the gentle natural motion; seamless calm loop, painted storybook style.
